title: Mouse reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#b8bcc8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#e8eaf0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='18' fill='#b8bcc8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='34' r='10' fill='#b8bcc8'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='34' r='6' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='34' r='10' fill='#b8bcc8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='34' r='6' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='4' fill='#3a3050'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='45' r='4' fill='#3a3050'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#e8a0a8'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='50' x2='38' y2='53' stroke='#8a8fa0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='56' x2='38' y2='56' stroke='#8a8fa0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='50' x2='62' y2='53' stroke='#8a8fa0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='56' x2='62' y2='56' stroke='#8a8fa0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book open -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='28' height='20' rx='2' fill='#f0c040' transform='rotate(-6 36 72)'/>
  <rect x='50' y='62' width='28' height='20' rx='2' fill='#f0c040' transform='rotate(6 64 72)'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x='24' y='64' width='24' height='16' rx='1' fill='#fff8e8' transform='rotate(-6 36 72)'/>
  <rect x='52' y='64' width='24' height='16' rx='1' fill='#fff8e8' transform='rotate(6 64 72)'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='28' y1='68' x2='44' y2='67' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='1.2' transform='rotate(-6 36 72)'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='72' x2='44' y2='71' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='1.2' transform='rotate(-6 36 72)'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='76' x2='40' y2='75' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='1.2' transform='rotate(-6 36 72)'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='67' x2='72' y2='68' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='1.2' transform='rotate(6 64 72)'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='71' x2='72' y2='72' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='1.2' transform='rotate(6 64 72)'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='75' x2='68' y2='76' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='1.2' transform='rotate(6 64 72)'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='61' width='4' height='22' rx='1' fill='#d8a020'/>
  <!-- paws holding book -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='80' r='4' fill='#b8bcc8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='4' fill='#b8bcc8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 85 Q88 85 86 70' fill='none' stroke='#e8a0a8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
